items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I remember it so much. And I had a picture... I think they've got this picture of Buddy and myself in there, and then he was a young guy and I was real young.

ctx.x: He never used one the whole time.

I read an interview that somebody did with Baby that has not been published. A guy down in New Orleans has it. And Baby claims that when he was working the Streckfuss line, that Bill Slingerland or whatever his first name was -- this had to be in the early '20s.
